name: Trae Stephens

lean.basis: No party role; interned for Republican congressman Rob Portman and led the Defense Department team on Trump's 2016–17 transition.

current_role: Co-founder and executive chairman of Anduril Industries; partner at Founders Fund
summary: Trae Stephens worked as a computational linguist in the intelligence community and was an early Palantir employee before joining Peter Thiel's Founders Fund as a partner in 2014. He led the Pentagon transition for President-elect Trump in 2016 and in 2017 co-founded the defense company Anduril with Palmer Luckey and other Palantir veterans; he is its executive chairman and a billionaire.
